method: Read content schema, editing guide, collection adapters, generated-site assertions, unit-test entrypoints, CI workflow, and all five prior audit summaries.
Ran historical check-records.mjs read-only. Independently compared its 82 recorded file hashes with current files.
Parsed all 89 tool frontmatters with existing Python YAML support and screened required tool presence, duplicate list members, dates, optional summaries/workflows and sources.
Transpiled the existing tool-schema declaration in memory and tested misspelled optional fields against generated Ruff metadata. No repository files or fixtures were modified.
No browser interaction, production build, analyzer installation/execution, or fresh upstream product verification by this agent.

metadata_screening.date_interpretation: Dates alone do not establish stale claims or failed source review. No future-dated entries found.
metadata_screening.ascii_scan: No non-ASCII or hidden control characters found in inspected tracked authored text extensions; binaries and unrecognized extensions excluded.

historical_ledger.check_result: Expected nonzero exit at first mismatch: src/content/docs/compare.md.
historical_ledger.interpretation: Later workflow/alias/usability changes explain why hashes differ. A mismatch does not prove the factual claims are incorrect or that no later review occurred.

findings.title: Misspelled optional tool fields are silently discarded
findings.reader_task: Author or extend a tool profile without silently losing reviewed workflows or discovery metadata
evidence: The custom tool schema uses z.object without strictness. analysisWorkflows, aliases and searchTerms default to empty lists; decision is optional.

In-memory tests of the exact existing schema replacing analysisWorkflows with analysisWorkflowsTypo, aliases with aliasesTypo, searchTerms with searchTermsTypo, or decision with decisionTypo all parse successfully. The first three become empty arrays; decision becomes absent.
Nested workflow objects already reject unknown fields through strict(), so the protection is inconsistent at the custom tool-object boundary.
No current malformed tool field was identified; this is a reproducible authoring guard gap, not a claim that present profiles lost metadata.
findings.impact: A new profile or newly added optional field can appear valid while omitting the intended builder workflow, alias, search vocabulary, or decision summary.
findings.recommended_change: Reject unrecognized keys within the custom tool object, with file/field diagnostics. Preserve genuinely absent optional fields. Scope strictness to project-owned tool metadata, not Starlight's entire frontmatter or extension namespace.
acceptance_criteria: Each misspelled optional field fails validation with a useful location/key message.
All 89 current profiles and 93 workflows still validate unchanged.
A profile intentionally omitting aliases, searchTerms, decision or workflows remains valid.
Supported Starlight metadata and future explicit project fields remain usable.
Add a focused negative schema test using authored tool metadata, not a generated record containing unrelated title/id fields.
findings.compatibility: No saved-system or public URL change; previously ignored misspellings become actionable authoring errors.

findings.title: Reconcile authored tool profiles against the published catalog
findings.reader_task: Add a tool page and know that it was admitted to the catalog or deliberately excluded
evidence: The custom docs extension allows tool to be absent for ordinary docs, and it has no tool-directory-specific requirement. An in-memory safeParse of the extension with toolTypo succeeds.
Catalog, comparison and builder collections include only entries with data.tool and without data.draft.

Generated discovery checks iterate the already-rendered catalog, so a new tool page missing metadata is not part of that expected set. builder.totalTools is compared with the same derived catalog and only a lower bound of80 workflow profiles is asserted.
Current inventory reconciliation found all 89 existing tool files represented. No current missing profile is alleged; full malformed-file build was not performed because this audit is read-only.
findings.impact: A newly added tools page can render as ordinary content and escape catalog membership checks, while validation of the remaining catalog still succeeds.
findings.confidence: high for source-level guard gap; end-to-end malformed-file build not attempted
findings.recommended_change: Add an authoring inventory check that requires valid tool metadata for published tool-profile files and compares their IDs with the generated catalog. Respect deliberate drafts. Keep workflow omission allowed and explicitly distinguished from accidental metadata omission.
acceptance_criteria: A new published tool-profile file without tool metadata fails with its path.
Each published profile appears exactly once in the catalog.
Draft profiles are deliberately excluded rather than treated as errors.
Ordinary guide/concept/research pages remain valid without tool metadata.
Catalog-only tools with zero reviewed workflows remain valid and visibly excluded from matching.
Use source identity sets, not a fixed89 count or an increased builder-count threshold.
dependencies: Coordinate with MNT-01 so diagnostics form one authoring validation path.
findings.compatibility: No reader URL or v1 saved-system changes. Folder exceptions, if introduced later, should be explicit rather than silently accepted.

findings.title: Separate current review status from immutable historical audit ledgers
findings.reader_task: Determine which current content still matches reviewed evidence and what needs reassessment
evidence: Historical checker correctly stops at compare.md's hash mismatch and is scoped to the 2026-09-22 snapshot of 60 profiles/82 files.
Independent current comparison finds62 of 82 recorded files changed, including53 of 60 tool profiles;29 current profiles were added after that ledger.
Later audit summaries document substantive follow-up reviews, but there is no single machine-readable map from current profile/claim scope to its latest relevant review and content hash.
The editing guide correctly tells authors not to advance verified without checking sources; it does not describe how to append or supersede a current review record after later edits.
The ledger mismatch does not establish inaccurate facts. Existing explicit uncertainty labels remain valuable.
findings.impact: Maintainers must reconstruct review provenance across historical reports and cannot quickly separate unchanged evidence, reviewed follow-up content, unreviewed changes, and new entries.
findings.recommended_change: Preserve old ledgers and add a separate read-only current review-status report that enumerates unchanged, changed-since-review, newly reviewed, and not-yet-linked-to-review content. Link newer review records and their scope/content digest. Human review decides whether a change affects claims; do not regenerate hashes or dates as a substitute.
acceptance_criteria: Report the whole current inventory rather than stopping at the first mismatch.
Show each latest applicable review reference and distinguish scope-limited follow-up review from blanket verification.
A later content change becomes visible without declaring its claims false or automatically changing verified.
Historical evidence and hashes remain intact.
A human can append a new review disposition without rerunning historical finalize.mjs.
Do not gate all CI work on the known old 62-file mismatch; treat the current report as review information until explicit policy is chosen.
dependencies: Coordinate with the reusable run-record proposal; documentation-review evidence and tool-execution records remain different artifacts.
findings.compatibility: Additive audit metadata/reporting; retain tool.verified meaning and existing evidence links.

findings.title: Add focused cross-surface regressions when fixing confirmed UI problems
findings.reader_task: Maintain working navigation and saved-state flows through future changes
evidence: Current tests cover pure catalog/comparison/matching functions plus generated links and selected real-catalog assertions.
The comparison return test exercises form fields and explicitly expects catalog root; it does not originate from Static/Dynamic routes.
The coordinator's 49 unit tests and generated-site checks pass while agent04 independently reproduced category loss through both actual profile and comparison return actions.
Prior browser checks are recorded as audit narratives, while the normal verification entrypoint does not exercise browser event wiring.
findings.impact: Function-level behavior can remain correct relative to its fixture while the rendered navigation drops part of the user's context.
findings.recommended_change: When implementing confirmed navigation and state fixes, add narrow regressions that include the actual originating route and cross-surface flow. Use generated assertions for static authoring behavior and a small browser smoke suite or maintained executable acceptance checklist for dynamic event/persistence wiring; avoid broad brittle snapshot coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Static/Dynamic -> profile -> return and catalog -> comparison -> return are covered with expected category, query and selection.
System save/reload and import rejection are tested at the UI boundary when those flows change, using isolated origin/fixtures.
Confirmed API-preset membership and source-only citation rendering receive the cheapest meaningful generated/content assertions.
Tests verify reader outcomes rather than copying implementation internals.
No global browser storage or existing user descriptions are modified by tests.
findings.effort: medium; start with regressions required by the first fixes
dependencies: ARC-01/SEA-01 navigation fix and other independently confirmed findings
findings.compatibility: Test infrastructure only; preserve behavior and avoid introducing an unrelated framework migration.
findings.consolidation_note: May be folded into acceptance criteria of the individual confirmed fixes rather than a separate product backlog item.

prior_audit_reconciliation.evidence: ToolCatalog has task shortcuts; agent04 identified API-preset membership gap. Preserve source-vs-dependency distinctions.
All titles/aliases checked in generated site;56 profiles have no aliases and58 no extra search terms (not automatic defects). Agent04 demonstrated null-pointer/taxonomy query gaps.
Seven authored toolChoices relationships and comparison links exist; general expansion remains curated work, not evidence that every profile needs every relation.
ToolCatalog derives unique option values; it displays total results, not counts per option with other filters retained.
System builder now represents host/target, interfaces and prerequisites. Catalog platform/integration/SARIF fields are not implemented; a blanket claim of completion would be wrong.
Docs checked and execution-status prose distinguish evidence. Source-backed structured lifecycle/status and current review map remain absent.
Comparison URLs retain selected tools; no compact catalog list view or named persistent shortlist system. No automatic need to add accounts.
mypy, ShellCheck, clang-tidy, UBSan, Trivy, Pyright, CPAchecker, KLEE and Grype all have current profiles.
detect-secrets fills file-oriented screening; Git-history scope and Gitleaks/Betterleaks maintenance review remain separate and are covered by agent05.
All 24 are present within 89 current profiles. Admission and documentation review do not establish locally executed examples.

prior_audit_reconciliation.item: Mobile, HDL, additional language and secret workflows
prior_audit_reconciliation.evidence: Current agent05 identifies scoped opportunities and primary evidence; absence is not proof of poor tool quality.
62 of 82 recorded files changed,53 of 60 tool profiles; do not rewrite old hashes to claim re-verification.
Profile retains historical-scope/current-availability caveats. This agent did not check new upstream evidence.
Known missing run record plus later failed setup are explicitly disclosed; no new execution in this audit.
Edition note continues to say current price unverified and launch pricing historical. No new account access or price verification.
Current metadata matches 93 workflows across 80 profiles,9 deliberately deferred. Deferral remains a coverage limitation rather than a matcher defect.

prior_audit_reconciliation.item: Shared layout and four detailed pilots
prior_audit_reconciliation.evidence: All 89 use shared renderer; exactly 4 supply decision metadata. Further first-result depth is an extension, not a failed promise that all 89 were rewritten.
Form fields are preserved; Static/Dynamic category was not included and remains a confirmed gap. No evidence that this subcase previously worked, so do not label it a regression.

prior_audit_reconciliation.item: Malformed memory comparison and authored guidance link checks
prior_audit_reconciliation.evidence: Generated validation now rejects dropped invalid/repeated tool IDs and checks authored comparison targets/fragments.

prior_audit_reconciliation.item: Blank-system prompts, question targeting and language search
prior_audit_reconciliation.evidence: Current tests include blank-part behavior, connection question host targeting and language-only candidate boundaries; further UI checks belong to agents07/11.
Coordinator retained restricted failure plus successful normal-permission rebuild/checks. Not a product sitemap defect.
Baseline retains warning while generating valid 404 and passing site checks. No evidence of reader-facing failure.

strengths: Required profile metadata is rich and all 89 current profiles supply it.
Workflow-specific findings and evidence membership checks prevent aggregate claim inflation.
Nested workflow and saved-system schemas use strict validation with useful bounds.
Generated checks validate actual catalog names/aliases, scoped query cases, authored comparison links and representative matching behavior.
Editing guidance clearly separates documentation review from execution evidence and forbids automatic verification-date updates.
Historical ledgers preserve source URLs, scope, hashes and caveats rather than replacing evidence with link-health success.
rejected_leads: No current missing tool metadata, duplicate list member, future verification date or authored non-ASCII text found in the screening.
A decision summary without a First try heading is already caught indirectly by generated local-fragment validation; no separate missing guard reported.
An old verification date or historical hash mismatch alone does not establish stale or false facts.
Initial Pagefind PermissionDenied and missing sitemap were environmental, resolved by coordinator retry.
Audit packaging *.log ignore was reported to coordinator and corrected to retained .txt logs; not a product finding.
